author: CareJobs.Now
description: Search open US healthcare jobs, see the hourly pay employers post, and look up employers and states, from Ruby or the command line. Talks to the free CareJobs.Now API (a remote MCP server, no API key) with the standard library only.

author: Abdelkader Boudih
description: Rails integration for Stampeded: an ActiveJob adapter, a worker that executes jobs, and a launcher for the precompiled daemon. Enqueueing is a plain INSERT in your own transaction, so a rolled-back transaction takes its jobs with it. Claiming goes through SQL functions shared with the Rust worker,…
